flagged.title: Reactivity of Metals and Metal Extraction
flagged.reason: Grouping magnesium and aluminium with potassium and sodium as reacting vigorously with water teaches a major misconception that loses marks on GCSE exam questions about metal reactions with water.

mark_affecting.quote: Up at the very top of the series, we've got our most reactive, top-tier metals. We're talking potassium, sodium, calcium, magnesium, and aluminium. These guys react vigorously.
